title: BASF APAC Chief: K-Beauty Must Look Beyond ‘Hero Ingredients’ to Delivery Systems and Formulation Science
summary: K-Beauty must evolve beyond its reliance on trending \"hero ingredients\" and double down on scientific validation, advanced delivery systems, and formulation science to sustain its global growth, according to a senior executive at German chemical giant BASF.In an exclusive written interview with The

extraction.key_fact_quote: "Discovering new ingredients alone is not enough," Wang said.
